description: Check untrusted text before your agent reads it (web pages, emails, social posts, tool results, documents): finds prompt-injection attempts such as instruction overrides, fake system or tool-call markers, hidden text, data-leak links and demands to move funds. Returns a verdict, a 0-1 risk score, each finding with its location, and a cleaned copy with hidden characters and flagged lines removed. With mode=memory it also guards long-term memory writes against planted history, standing orders and 'trusted' addresses. US$0.003 per call; 3 free calls a day.

context.description: Where it came from, e.g. 'web page', 'tweet'.

mode.description: 'memory' when the text is about to be saved to long-term memory.

name: check_prompt_injection
title: Check text for prompt injection
